Faith is the substance of things hoped for (Hebrews 11:1), so we have to have our imagination working to understand the things of God. You must be able to see and hear with your heart to ever be able to receive spiritual truths. An unsaved person can not perceive spiritual truths (Acts 28:26-27), and it takes the born again spirit to enable our hearts to understand them. Thank you Lord for giving us the ability to know you, through our born again spirits.
